errors.text: The proposed SPS/compositional-tailoring intervention does not reconstruct the 4.2 at.% Cr addition by vacuum arc melting.
It predicts suppression of all secondary phases, whereas the target mechanism requires approximately 4 vol.% of an interconnected Cr2(Ti,Zr,Hf,Ta) Laves phase.
The baseline is incorrectly changed from HfMoTaTiZr to HfNbTaTiZr and is assigned incompatible phase and ductility characteristics.
The claimed density below 8.5 g/cm3 is unsupported and is unlikely for Hf15Mo15Ta15Ti25Zr30; a simple rule-of-mixtures estimate is around 9 g/cm3.
The evidence does not substantiate the proposed composition, cooling-rate thresholds, oxygen threshold, mechanical-property targets, or density prediction.
The falsification tests mostly violate the hypothesis's own stated boundaries, so failure under those conditions would not logically falsify it.
